chapter.heading: The Words of King Lemuel’s Mother
chapter.v:
The words
of King Lemuel, the utterance which his mother taught him: [Ezek. 3:12,]

What, my
son?And what, son of my womb?And what, son of my vows?

Do not
give your strength to women,Nor your ways to that which destroys kings. [Ezek. 12:22, 27; 2 Pet. 3:4 e Jer. 1:13; Ezek. 11:7,]

It is
not for kings, O Lemuel,It is not for kings to drink wine,Nor for princes intoxicating drink;

Lest they
drink and forget the law,And pervert the justice of all the afflicted. [Ezek. 2:2; 3:24 g [Jer. 16:17; 17:10]]

Give strong
drink to him who is perishing,And wine to those who are bitter of heart. [Is. 1:15; Ezek.]

Let him
drink and forget his poverty,And remember his misery no more. [Ezek. 24:3, 6; Mic. 3:2, 3 j 2 Kin. 25:18-22; Jer. 52:24-27; Ezek.]

Open your
mouth for the speechless,In the cause of all who are appointed to die. [Jer. 42:16]

Open your
mouth, judge righteously,And plead the cause of the poor and needy.The Virtuous Wife [Ezek. 5:8]

Who can
find a virtuous wife?For her worth is far above rubies. [2 Kin. 25:19- 21; Jer. 39:6; 52:10 n 1 Kin. 8:65; 2 Kin. 14:25 o Ps. 9:16; Ezek. 6:7; 13:9, 14,]

The heart
of her husband safely trusts her;So he will have no lack of gain. [Ezek. 11:3,]

She does
him good and not evilAll the days of her life. [Lev. 18:3, 24; Deut. 12:30, 31; Ezek. 8:10, 14,]

She seeks
wool and flax,And willingly works with her hands. [Acts 5:5] [Ezek. 9:8]

She is
like the merchant ships,She brings her food from afar. [Ezek. 10:19]

She also
rises while it is yet night,And provides food for her household,And a portion for her maidservants.

She considers
a field and buys it;From her profits she plants a vineyard. [Ps. 90:1; 91:9; Is. 8:14; Jer. 29:7,]

She girds
herself with strength,And strengthens her arms. [Is. 11:11-16; Jer. 3:12, 18; 24:5; Ezek. 20:41, 42;]

She perceives
that her merchandise is good,And her lamp does not go out by night. [Ezek. 37:23]

She stretches
out her hands to the distaff,And her hand holds the spindle. [Jer. 32:39; Ezek. 36:26; Zeph. 3:9 x Ps. 51:10; [Jer. 31:33]; Ezek. 18:31 y Zech. 7:12;]

She extends
her hand to the poor,Yes, she reaches out her hands to the needy. [Ps. 105:45]

She is
not afraid of snow for her household,For all her household is clothed with scarlet. [Ezek. 9:10]

She makes
tapestry for herself;Her clothing is fine linen and purple. [Ezek. 1:19]

Her husband
is known in the gates,When he sits among the elders of the land. [Zech. 14:4 f Ezek.] [Ezek. 8:4; 9:3]

She makes
linen garments and sells them,And supplies sashes for the merchants. [Ezek. 8:3; 2 Cor. 12:2-4]

Strength and
honor are her clothing;She shall rejoice in time to come.

She opens
her mouth with wisdom,And on her tongue is the law of kindness.

She watches
over the ways of her household,And does not eat the bread of idleness.

Her children
rise up and call her blessed;Her husband also, and he praises her:

“Many daughters
have done well,But you excel them all.”

Charm is
deceitful and beauty is passing,But a woman who fears the Lord, she shall be praised.

Give her
of the fruit of her hands,And let her own works praise her in the gates.
